children.name: Marsilea
children.description: Marsilea — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Marsilea × subangulata
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Trop. America. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea aegyptiaca
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Greece, N. Africa to Sahara, S, Africa, Madagascar, Arabian Pen., E. European Russia to N. Xinjiang and N. India. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea aethiopica
children.description: The native range of this species is Egypt, Ethiopia. It grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Marsilea ancylopoda
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & Subtrop. America. It is a helophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea angustifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Western Australia to N. Northern Territory.

children.name: Marsilea apposita
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Zimbabwe to S. Africa.

children.name: Marsilea batardae
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Portugal to SW. Spain. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Marsilea berhautii
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Trop. Africa. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea botryocarpa
children.description: The native range of this species is Kenya.

children.name: Marsilea burchellii
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Africa. It is a perennial or helophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea capensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Zambia to S. Africa. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea coromandelina
children.description: The native range of this species is Africa, India, Sri Lanka. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea costulifera
children.description: The native range of this species is Australia.

children.name: Marsilea crenata
children.description: The native range of this species is Indo-China to Australia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea crotophora
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mexico, Nicaragua, Venezuela (Barinas) to Bolivia.

children.name: Marsilea cryptocarpa
children.description: The native range of this species is Northern Territory to South Australia.

children.name: Marsilea deflexa
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico to S. Trop. America.

children.name: Marsilea distorta
children.description: The native range of this species is Sahel, Tanxania to N. Namibia.

children.name: Marsilea drummondii
children.description: The native range of this species is Australia. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea ephippiocarpa
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Trop. & S. Africa.

children.name: Marsilea exarata
children.description: The native range of this species is Australia.

children.name: Marsilea fadeniana
children.description: The native range of this species is Kenya.

children.name: Marsilea farinosa
children.description: The native range of this species is Ethiopia to S. Africa.

children.name: Marsilea fenestrata
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mozambique to KwaZulu-Natal.

children.name: Marsilea gibba
children.description: The native range of this species is Burkina Faso to Ethiopia and N. Zambia. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea globulosa
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea hirsuta
children.description: The native range of this species is Australia. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea latzii
children.description: The native range of this species is Northern Territory (Tanami Desert).

children.name: Marsilea macrocarpa
children.description: The native range of this species is Kenya to S. Africa, Madagascar. It is a perennial or helophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea macropoda
children.description: The native range of this species is New Mexico to C. & S. Texas and NE. Mexico.

children.name: Marsilea megalomanica
children.description: The native range of this species is Tanzania.

children.name: Marsilea minuta
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & Subtrop. Old World. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea mollis
children.description: The native range of this species is Arizona to Texas and Mexico, W. South America to Argentina (Jujuy, Tucumán).

children.name: Marsilea mutica
children.description: The native range of this species is N. & E. Australia, New Caledonia. It is a rhizomatous hydrogeophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea nashii
children.description: The native range of this species is Bahamas to Turks-Caicos Is..

children.name: Marsilea nubica
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. Africa to Namibia, Madagascar. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea oligospora
children.description: The native range of this species is W. U.S.A..

children.name: Marsilea owambo
children.description: The native range of this species is Ethiopia, W. Zimbabwe to Namibia. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea polycarpa
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mexico to Trop. America. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea pyriformis
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea quadrata
children.description: The native range of this species is Borneo.

children.name: Marsilea quadrifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is Canary Is., Europe to Japan and Iran. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Marsilea scalaripes
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Indo-China to N. Pen. Malaysia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea schelpeana
children.description: The native range of this species is Cape Prov.. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Marsilea strigosa
children.description: The native range of this species is Medit. to Transcaucasus (Talysh), E. Europe to W. Siberia, C. Asia to E. Afghanistan. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Marsilea subterranea
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Trop. Africa to Tanzania.

children.name: Marsilea unicornis
children.description: The native range of this species is Angola to Namibia.

children.name: Marsilea vestita
children.description: The native range of this species is Canada to Mexico, Bahamas, Barbuda, Peru,.

children.name: Marsilea villifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is Namibia to Northern Prov..

children.name: Marsilea villosa
children.description: The native range of this species is Hawaiian Is. (Niʻihau, Oʻahu, Molokai).

children.name: Pilularia
children.description: Pilularia — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Pilularia americana
children.description: The native range of this species is S. U.S.A. to Venezuela, Bolivia to Brazil (Rio Grande do Sul) and S. South America. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Pilularia bokkeveldensis
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Cape Prov..

children.name: Pilularia dracomontana
children.description: The native range of this species is KwaZulu-Natal (SE. Drakensberg). It is a helophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Pilularia ethiopica
children.description: The native range of this species is Ethiopia. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Pilularia globulifera
children.description: The native range of this species is Europe to Kazakhstan, Ethiopia. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Pilularia minuta
children.description: The native range of this species is Medit.. It is a perennial or tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Pilularia novae-hollandiae
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. & SE. Australia, New Zealand. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Regnellidium
children.description: Regnellidium — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Regnellidium diphyllum
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Brazil to Argentina (Corrientes). It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
